messages:
Maria: FYI — noticed another GPU spend spike this morning. Top offenders: sandbox-mlplay (20%), inference-batch (12%), and a handful of teams with untagged pools. Proposing we add stratified alerts: env-level (prod/dedicated/private), tag-level (team/customer), and workload-type (training vs inference). @Lee @Aj any blockers?

Aj: Sounds good. Need to confirm tagging is reliable first — last week ~7% untagged. We can add a fallback that groups by project id when tag missing.

Sam: Agreed on workload split. We should surface model-size and seq_len percentiles too. Suggest SQL snippet to compute spend by workload:

```
SELECT team, workload_type, SUM(gpu_cost) as cost
FROM billing.gpu_usage
GROUP BY team, workload_type
ORDER BY cost DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

Lee: :+1: Can we make alerts that escalate? e.g., warn at 70% of budget, page at 100%+; and only page for prod teams. Non-prod should hit slack-only alerts.

Olivia: Approve the idea. Quick ask: can we get a 30-day rolling forecast to tune thresholds? If spike is transient we don't want noisy pages.

CostBot: automated report
CostBot: daily-gpu-summary — https://internal.redwood/reports/daily-gpu?ts=2034567800 :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Maria: Thanks — action items:
- Aj to run tag backfill for untagged pools by EOD Thu
- Sam to run workload-type classifier on usage (train vs infer)
- Lee to draft alerting policies + escalation matrix
- Finance to provide 30-day rolling baseline (Maria)

Aj: noted. I'll post PR for the backfill script and include metrics to show confidence.

Sam: Will add a small eval set to check classifier precision; aim to land by Fri.

Lee: Drafting now, will share in #eng-sre once initial draft done.

Maria: If we can get this in place before next billing cycle we can avoid a surprise chargeback. Ping me if you need budget approvals. :handshake:

Olivia: Thanks team. :rocket:
